match.userMessage: Storyboard animatic frame. close-up. slightly above. Mina’s open palm and coral lipstick sit in the sunlit foreground while Scarlett and the glowing skyline fall softly behind. Mina holds the coral lipstick open in her palm while facing Scarlett, both women smiling beside the rooftop wall. Then: Mina closes her fingers around the lipstick, takes Scarlett’s hand, and pulls her toward the stairwell. Camera: pull-out, smooth. Characters: Scarlett: Woman, 27, A 27-year-old woman of average height with a slim, active build, warm medium skin, expressive dark eyes, and dark brown hair worn loose to the shoulders. Her face is youthful, with defined brows and a quick, open smile. Her appearance becomes visibly brighter as the coral lipstick brings color to her complexion, wearing Black fitted turtleneck, black wool coat carried or worn. Mina: Woman, Late 20s, A woman in her late 20s with an average height and softly angular features, tired eyes, and expressive brows. Her hair is medium-to-dark brown, shoulder length, and easily lifted by the rooftop wind. Her face visibly transforms from exhausted to amused after applying the lipstick, wearing Green utility jacket with a roomy pocket, simple dark top, dark trousers or jeans, and.
